summary: Child custody from grandparents; natural guardian father's right affirmed; welfare of child primary; Habeas Corpus maintainable; academic year completion considered; phased transfer of custody ordered; visitation rights to grandparents post-transfer; Guardian O.P. to be closed.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 226 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; custody to be transferred to father from 01.05.2025; interim visitation rights to father during transition; grandparents retain visitation rights post-custody transfer; Guardian O.P. to stand closed; parties to bear own costs.
